data_use: Whole input was used in prior K.P study. This is a development execution-model and frozen-Squeeze comparison, never fresh/OOS. Do not select another period after outputs.
independent_approval: A separate maintainer-published Git commit parent-linked to the reviewed source at the fixed approval ref binds reviewed parent, contract and all current source/workflow hashes. The activation cannot authorize itself. The driver never creates/updates approval; repository ref administrators remain trusted.
preexecution_revision: P1 output-before-reservation fix4178649820 and explicit preactivation owner transfer; old contract/claims not reset. Signal, lifecycle, input, period and cost semantics unchanged.
reservation: Permanent atomically created Git ref for the unchanged batch, created before signal generation. Exact first Actions attempt and activation-only commit. Never delete or reuse the claim, including after failure.
scope_basis: User requested next efficient step after explicit shared timing repair and next frozen Squeeze comparison. Two pre-existing identities, one fixed comparison, no new strategy or search. Not a replenishment of PR1355 allowance.

semantics.availability: maximum recorded receipt clock of all six symbols and all earlier price prefixes; historical seed/config assumed available before evaluation, NOT realtime-certified
semantics.cost: identical trades charged frozen reference cost then2x; not leverage; no true funding/margin/NAV claim
semantics.decision_bars: 30m frozen source functions and regime fit, no retuning
semantics.entry: first 1m open strictly after recorded availability; reject if first entry reaches next 30m decision close
semantics.hold: count full post-entry 30m management bars, frozen maximum from source
semantics.management: Only full30m bars starting at/after entry trigger management; activate first later1m open after six-symbol price prefix arrives. MFE/MAE include every closed post-entry minute actually received before that activation, including after the trigger bar close; unreceived minutes excluded. Incomplete entry bar is not a30m trigger.
semantics.mfe_reporting: MFE/MAE reports only received post-entry prefix at last management observation, not full eventual path.
semantics.non_goals: No proof of live tradability, complete data-use census, untouched OOS, funding/margin or account DD. No running-consumer deployment.
semantics.reservation: independent research accounts per identity, one position per symbol; ownership held to recorded exit witness; unresolved holds permanently
semantics.stop: initial resting protection from entry; price gaps at adverse open, otherwise 1m stop-first model

stop_condition: Both identities complete once or preserve failure. No automatic retry, no extra variants, no threshold/period search. Preserve all old evidence.
